General information about the Bachelor of Science in Public Health Program

  • The CDU Bachelor of Science in Public Health (BSPH) program in Urban Health Disparities provides the next generation of scholars, public health practitioners, and future clinicians a rich educational foundation which integrates theoretical, applied, and social justice knowledge to public health research, practice, and policy. 
  • The BSPH program offers a public health curriculum through a social justice lens that integrates the foundational public health domains, knowledge, skills, and research experience. The BSPH program curriculum enhances our graduates’ ability to translate and apply the newly gained public health knowledge and skills to public health practice, graduate and clinical programs. Our program faculty provides a supportive and accessible learning environment to engage critically with course materials and share opportunities to gain hands-on experience.
  • Maximum time for degree completion for freshmen is 8 Years 
  • Maximum transfer credit: 75 units
